info.title: Stermont product photo ingest
info.description: Downloads a vendor product photo from a public HTTPS URL, validates it, stores the real bytes in Neon Object Storage, verifies the stored object, and attaches it to one product. Never changes active, price, stock, slug or product_code.

post.summary: Store a vendor photo for one product and attach it

product_code.description: Permanent product code, for example STM-001845

image_url.description: Direct public HTTPS URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, at least 500x500 px and over 15 KB

source_page_url.description: HTTPS product page the image came from

source_name.description: Business or site name of the source

rights_note.description: What the source terms or permission allow (at least 15 characters)

pack_match_note.description: How the photo matches the exact product and pack size (at least 10 characters)

alt_text.description: Accurate alt text describing the photo

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image

502.description: Download, storage or verification failed; product not changed
